known_limitations: A colocated file checkpoint is a local verification fixture, not an independent freshness source.
Coordinated rollback of SQLite and the matching local checkpoint is accepted and requires an independently administered monotonic or immutable anchor to detect.
Checkpoint equality does not authenticate the source or prove pre-migration truth.
The judging matrix uses fixed synthetic arrays and proves local routing only; it does not demonstrate field accuracy, AWS execution, or an executed action.
The demo contract is PREPARED_NOT_RECORDED and does not establish that a video, live camera run, or AWS deployment exists.
The final-video gate and receipt templates are prepared only; no final video or independent review exists.
Scene-pipeline metrics come from a synthetic generator written by the same author as the detector; they do not establish field accuracy.
The capture replay ledger is per process / per Lambda execution environment, not global.
execution_environment in endpoint responses is self-reported; the Lambda emulator reports AWS_LAMBDA locally.
